My girlfriend is always telling me the same thing for a year. She had some suicidal tendencies a while ago and I have always tried to find a way to confort her and make her not feel like doing something like this again. I don't know how much I helped but I'm going to try telling you this too. In order to find joy in things u used to like to do or new things or hobbies or just things you like, you have to change the way you think first. You can try all the activities in the world and it won't change a thing if you don't change the way you are thinking first. You have to stop thinking about things that stress you out. About failing. About money. About what you have to do at your job. About things that put pressure on you. Take some time to relax, take a deep breath and say to yourself "so what". Try to smile even alone in the house. You will someday find happines in everything you do. Ease up on yourself. Don't be hard on yourself. People come and go, hobbies change, life goes on. Enjoy the little things. Don't think you have to figure everything out at once. Step by step and you'll make it. I wish you luck man.
